newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Weifu lands 800 mln yuan purchase orders.
newsitem.headline: Weifu lands 800 mln yuan purchase orders.

text.p: China's Jiangsu-based Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd, has received purchase orders worth about 800 million yuan for delivery in 1997, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times reported on Monday.

The company, which makes fuel-injection systems for cars, is expanding its production capacity to meet this stronger demand next year, the newspaper said. No other details were given and company officials were unavailable for comment.
The newspaper said the firm continued to perform well in the third quarter and expects to report an improvement over 1995 third-quarter results. It did not issue a profit forecast.
The company's 1995 annual report said after-tax profits, under international accounting standards, totalled 62.98 million yuan in calendar 1995, up from 53.37 million in 1994.
Weifu claimed net earnings of 33.20 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up from 29.37 million in the January-June period of 1995.

Weifu said the higher first-half profits resulted from a 22.26 percent increase in its operating income, which reached 244.98 million yuan, up from 200.37 million in the first half of 1995 thanks to a drive to expand sales.
